description: Build the steps that claim rewards. Pass `rewards` exactly as quote_claim returned them. 'compound' requires slippage. Returns UNSIGNED transaction steps for the owner to sign in order; this server never holds keys or sends transactions. The build expires after 180 seconds (`expiresAt`, unix ms): build immediately before signing, not as a plan for later. Builds are single-use: rebuilding an open predicts a different position address, so never replay one. A successful build does not guarantee a successful transaction: pass `steps` to `simulate` and check `ok` before asking anyone to sign.

owner.description: EOA that owns the position and signs the steps. The smart account is derived from it server-side.

slippage.description: Slippage tolerance as a decimal: 0.005 means 0.5% (not 1e18 fixed-point)
